goal: Training factory: scripts/experiment_runner.py takes a config (model_size, data_mix, hparams, stages) and produces a deterministically-named checkpoint + manifest. Sweep helper enumerates a config matrix. experiments/INDEX.md ledger tracks every run with config + final loss + eval scores.
resolution: Training factory operational: scripts/experiment_runner.py + scripts/run_sweep.py + experiments/configs/_template.yaml + 5 seed configs. Each run produces deterministic experiments/runs/<name>/{checkpoint.pt, MANIFEST.json, train.log}. scripts/eval_checkpoint.py grades any checkpoint against the GAD-tool eval, scripts/eval_all_experiments.py walks them, scripts/sweep_report.py builds REPORT.md. Validated end-to-end with 5 hyperparam variants — best run higher_lr 1/30 (3.3%) vs 0/30 baseline.
